concepts.name: Stone Council
concepts.description: CSS-cut limestone table, royal ledger, stamped counters and decree cards. All game visuals drawn in code; no atlas, illustration, SVG or ready-made texture.

selection.reason: The selected law becomes the centre of interaction; board and hand stay immediately visible.

tools.reason: All visible gameplay geometry, effects, typography, card papers and board cells authored in CSS.

assets.role: Original small bitmap for PWA/OS icon only

risks: Visual browser capture and touch-safe-area acceptance must be run in CI.
